$comment: ADR-036 Amendment 2 fixture: a browser editor's page lifecycle. JSON-RPC 2.0 frames on the browser client's /ws session (ADR-099), as the daemon's own test sends them (daemon/src/collab_handler/tests/collab_handler_page_lifecycle_tests.rs, which pins this file). Clients branch on error.data.kind only. Identifiers, keys and signatures are the test's; field names, kinds and the order of steps are normative.

contract.node_id: The client mints it: a UUID v4.
contract.signing: Every change below is signed with the person's member key: kb/node_update with signOp (maecontent/v1), the two list methods with signManifestOp (maemanifest/v1, mae-crypto 0.4.0). The header fields (author, author_pubkey, epoch as decimal text, issued_at, sig) sit beside the method's own params.
contract.create: kb/node_update of the new node first (its content exists, unlisted: nothing else sees it yet), then kb/collection_node_add with its title (it is listed). Never the reverse: a listed node without content would be listed empty.
contract.rename: kb/node_update changing the node's title, then kb/collection_node_add of the same node_id with the new title. An add of an existing node_id is an upsert: it retitles, it is not refused. The listed title does not follow the content by itself; a client shows both and retries the add when they differ.
contract.delete: kb/collection_node_remove, with no title. A node holding any publication-review revision is refused (see the refusals); derogate it instead.
contract.notification: Each list change reaches every other session subscribed to kbc:<kb_id> as one sync_update event. A node's own kb/node_update is not a list change and sends none to them.
contract.switch: [collab.auth] require_signed_content_ops. Off, an unsigned change is accepted and counted; on, refused signature_required. A signed change that fails verification is refused at any setting.

params.update: <base64 yrs update: the new node's document>
params.author: <the signer's member-key fingerprint>

error.message: unsigned content op for KB 'kb-hv' node '5f0c2a9e-8d1b-4c3e-9a7f-2b6d4e8c1a03' rejected: this daemon requires signed content ops (ADR-036 require-signed)
signed manifest op rejected: the signature does not verify, or its key is not the author's
manifest op signed by <fingerprint> sent by session <fingerprint>: a session may send only ops it authored (ADR-036 Amendment 1 F4)
signed manifest op rejected: a stale epoch
